en.p: Over all sequences $\{a_n\}$ whose terms are all natural numbers and which satisfy the following conditions, let $M$ and $m$ be the maximum and minimum values of $a_9$, respectively. What is the value of $M+m$? [4 points]

box: $a_{n+2}=\begin{cases} a_{n+1}+a_n & (\text{if } a_{n+1} \text{ is not a multiple of } 3) \\ \dfrac{1}{3}a_{n+1} & (\text{if } a_{n+1} \text{ is a multiple of } 3) \end{cases}$
